title: Virtual networks and subnets
summary: A virtual network provides a private network space. Subnets divide that space into smaller address ranges for resources.
introduction: A virtual network provides a private network space. Subnets divide that space into smaller address ranges for resources. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A virtual network provides a private network space. Subnets divide that space into smaller address ranges for resources.
The example subnet ranges are separate. Network routes and access rules decide how traffic moves.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Draw which resources would belong in each subnet.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not confuse an address range with a permission to access a service.
For more detail later, use this [Microsoft Azure further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/azure-setup-guide/).

seo.title: Microsoft Azure: Virtual networks and subnets
